intro: Having proven their basic tracking and stalking skills in the rolling hills of Mulgore, young tauren are directed outward into the arid wilderness of the Barrens. Melor Stonehoof sends aspiring hunters north of the border to report to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. This journey marks the hunter's formal transition from local trials to the demanding predatory hierarchy of Kalimdor's broader plains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens. Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce. You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.
Speak with Sergra Darkthorn. She will be your first guide in the Barrens.

Sergra is at the Crossroads. To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks. And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You want to hunt in the Barrens?
Your eyes are eager, and young. They're not yet squinted from tracking your prey across this land's dry plains.
But worry not. We'll toughen your body and your mind. And we'll teach you that there is more to hunting than finding and killing your quarry.
Prepare yourself. Your journey begins. Now.
